name: Oni sdelany iz mjasa
source: "They're Made Out of Meat" is a short story by Terry Bisson. The story is structured as a dialogue between two beings. They are intelligent beings who can travel faster than light. They are on a mission to find intelligent species and introduce them to other inhabitants of the universe.
